issues.description: Resource IDs are interpolated into URL paths without percent-encoding, allowing slash/query/path traversal characters to alter the requested endpoint.
Retry policy only handles HTTP responses and does not retry transient httpx transport errors such as timeouts, disconnects, or connection failures.
Retry-After parsing ignores valid HTTP-date values, so standards-compliant rate-limit responses may not be honored.
Backoff cap is applied before jitter, so actual sleep can exceed backoff_cap despite the documented upper bound.
Constructor validates max_attempts but not timeout, backoff_base, or backoff_cap, allowing invalid negative values to fail later at runtime.
Successful response bodies are trusted without schema checks, so malformed 2xx API responses raise raw KeyError/JSON errors instead of typed client errors.
BatchItemResult accepts inconsistent API payloads, such as created results without tasks or error results without errors, instead of validating invariants.
Package does not ship a py.typed marker, so downstream type checkers will not reliably treat this advertised typed client as typed under PEP 561.
Mock pagination cursors store only offsets, not snapshots, so inserted or removed items between pages can cause duplicate or skipped mock results.
Package version is duplicated separately from pyproject.toml, creating release drift risk.
Package metadata is minimal and lacks license, authors, classifiers, and project URLs needed for a publishable library.
